name: CityGaussian / VastGaussian / DoGaussian
definition: Divides the city into tiles, trains per tile, merges with overlap; uses LoD pyramid for streaming.
summary: CityGaussian, VastGaussian, and DoGaussian are block-based partitioning methods that enable city-scale 3D Gaussian Splatting by training independent models per tile and merging them at render time.
